source_note: This lab explicitly compares a switchboard that keeps lifecycle reward updates with one that observes the same rewards but freezes its action-reward memory.

decision.reason: Lifecycle rewards can update switchboard action preferences without reducing survival or need balance in this Stage 0 scenario.

limitations: The reward function is still synthetic and hand-authored.
The scenario starts from deliberately miscalibrated action rewards.
No persisted online learner state is promoted into packages yet.
No human non-annoyance or attachment rating is included.
